cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI -2.46% · Brent +1.29% · NatGas -3.98%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.14%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.14%; weakest is Shale & E&P at +0.15%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at +5.46%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +5.46%, BE +3.29%, UEC +2.43%, UUUU +2.31%, LEU +2.06%. Laggards: FANG -0.47%, ARRY -0.30%, MPLX -0.12%, SHEL -0.08%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
